name: investsmart
description: InvestSmart — Plataforma académica de simulação, análise e comparação de investimentos financeiros.

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npm run db:local:start && npm run dev
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm run db:start && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
